resources.string: A computer with your MCP token can wake and unlock this phone.
Not configured · swipe or no screen lock only
Unlock paused · check and save the credential again on this phone

Off by default. Credentials stay encrypted on this phone and are never sent to a model or computer. One failed credential attempt pauses further attempts. After a restart, unlock the phone yourself once first. Phone control must be set up.
Use the current 4–16 digit PIN. Saving again allows one new attempt after a failure.
Use the current 4–64 character password: English letters, numbers, spaces and common ASCII symbols. Other characters and pattern locks are not supported.
Could not save. Check the phone storage and try again.
